items.informal_name: Division Distributes Over Finite Sum in Division Semiring
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K),
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a
items.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of elements of type $\iota$ and a function $f : \iota \to K$ where $K$ is a division semiring, and for any element $a \in K$, the division of the sum $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)$ by $a$ is equal to the sum of each $f(i)$ divided by $a$. Formally, $\left( \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right) / a = \sum_{i \in s} \left( f(i) / a \right)$.

items.informal_name: Distributivity of Scalar Division Over Multiset Sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (s : Multiset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K),
  (Multiset.map (fun x => f x / a) s).sum = (Multiset.map f s).sum / a
items.informal_description: For any multiset $ s $, function $ f : \iota \to K $, and element $ a \in K $, where $ K $ is a division semiring, the sum of the multiset obtained by dividing each element $ f(x) $ by $ a $ is equal to the sum of the multiset $ f(x) $ divided by $ a $. In symbols, $$\sum_{x \in s} \frac{f(x)}{a} = \frac{1}{a} \sum_{x \in s} f(x).$$

items.informal_name: Distributivity of Division Over Addition in Division Semirings
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (a b c : K), (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c
items.informal_description: For all elements $a, b, c$ in a division semiring $K$, it holds that $\frac{a + b}{c} = \frac{a}{c} + \frac{b}{c}$.

items.informal_name: Addition of Fractions with Common Denominator in Division Semirings
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (a b c : K), a / c + b / c = (a + b) / c
items.informal_description: For any elements $a$, $b$, and $c$ in a division semiring $K$, the sum of $\frac{a}{c}$ and $\frac{b}{c}$ is equal to $\frac{a + b}{c}$. In symbols, $\frac{a}{c} + \frac{b}{c} = \frac{a + b}{c}$.

items.informal_name: Sum Division Equality for Divisible Terms in Integers
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℤ} {n : ℤ}, (∀ i ∈ s, n ∣ f i) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / n = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / n
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to \mathbb{Z} $, if $ n $ divides each $ f(i) $ for all $ i \in s $, then $ \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i \in s} f(i) = \sum_{i \in s} \frac{f(i)}{n} $.

items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} (a a' : α → γ) (b b' : β → γ) [inst : Div γ],
